The user wants to know the result of 17 multiplied by 23.
$17 \times 23$.

    *   Method 1: Standard multiplication.
        *   $17 \times 20 = 340$
        *   $17 \times 3 = 51$
        *   $340 + 51 = 391$
    *   Method 2: Difference of squares (since 17 and 23 are equidistant from 20).
        *   $17 = 20 - 3$
        *   $23 = 20 + 3$
        *   $(20 - 3)(20 + 3) = 20^2 - 3^2$
        *   $400 - 9 = 391$
391.
